raw_block.rationale: Create a narrowly scoped section 3306(c)(5) applicability helper for the uncovered family-employment trigger. It reads only the current employee-to-employer relationship and applies both statutory family-service branches without disturbing the installed termination-payment helper.

inputs.name: employee_to_employer_relationship
inputs.question: What is the current employee's relationship to the employer, normalized as employee_is_parent_of_employer, employee_is_spouse_of_employer, employee_is_child_of_employer_under_21, or other?

skill.intent: Determine whether a positive claim that section 3306(c)(5) applies is supported by the current employee-to-employer family relationship, returning the native binary label.

outputs.description: The native label Entailment when section 3306(c)(5) applies to the stated family employment, otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: qualifying_family_relationships

origin.quote:
(A) service performed by an individual in the employ of his son, daughter, or spouse;

        (B) service performed by a child under the age of 21 in the employ of his father or mother;

premises.question: Which employee-to-employer family relationships fall within section 3306(c)(5)?

fields.name: employee_to_employer_relationship
fields.question: What qualifying or nonqualifying family relationship connects the current employee to the employer?

reads.question: Read the current employment facts to identify the employee's family relationship to the employer, including the under-21 condition when the employee is the employer's child.
